{{Top|leg}}
'''Drev''' was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Drev commented on the entry for the [[NR-5 Series Repair Droid]], providing information about a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] known as [[Faddo]] who was a sales rep for [[Tredwall]] and their [[NR knockoff|knockoff]] version of the NR-5.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
